hooks.command: git fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null; git pull --rebase --autostash -q origin $(git branch --show-current) 2>/dev/null; git merge -q --no-edit origin/main 2>/dev/null || git merge --abort 2>/dev/null; true

git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -q -m "auto: claude update"); git pull --rebase --autostash -q origin $(git branch --show-current) 2>/dev/null; git push -q -u origin HEAD 2>/dev/null; true
